_comment: Hand-picked cards. Players are matched to the stats CSV by team + jersey (goalkeepers to stats counted from the events CSV). Attribute values are NOT stored here: the backend reads them from the data so they can't drift. 'title' is the card's archetype, the one thing this player stood for in the game; it is the only stat-like text on the card face. 'position' is not in the dataset; it comes from the public team rosters. 'video' is null until an authorized clip exists. Player photos come from docs/player-images.json, matched by team + jersey. New accounts get a starter pack of 'pack_size' random cards; more cards are unlocked through the trivia (see 'archetypes': the clue shown in each question; 'archetype_metrics': the KPIs behind each archetype).

archetypes.Sniper: Lives for the goal: scores and shoots to put the puck in the net.
archetypes.Playmaker: Creates for others: involved in goals through assists and accurate passing.
archetypes.Volume Shooter: Keeps pulling the trigger: took more shots than anyone else.
archetypes.Chance Creator: Generates the most dangerous scoring chances in the game (expected goals).
archetypes.Speedster: Fastest skater on the ice and wins the battles for the puck.
archetypes.Shot Blocker: Puts their body in front of shots to protect the goal.
archetypes.Workhorse: Plays the most minutes and skates the farthest.
archetypes.Go-To Scorer: The main scoring threat on their team: leads their side in shots and expected goals.
archetypes.Shot Stopper: The goalkeeper who makes the most saves.

archetype_metrics._comment: The three KPIs that earn a player each archetype (see the definitions in 'archetypes'). The card back shows these, and the clips next to it come from the events behind them.

cards.title: Sniper
cards.explanation: Scored twice, once in the first period and once in the second, and set up another goal in Davos's 6–3 win.

cards.title: Playmaker
cards.explanation: Was involved in three goals (one goal, two assists), won most of the faceoffs taken and completed almost every pass.

cards.title: Volume Shooter
cards.explanation: Took more shots than anyone else in the game and scored in the third period.

cards.title: Chance Creator
cards.explanation: Created the most dangerous scoring chances of anyone in the match, measured by expected goals, and scored Davos's final goal late in the third period.

cards.title: Speedster
cards.explanation: Reached the highest skating speed in the game and won more puck battles than any other player.

cards.title: Shot Blocker
cards.explanation: Blocked more shots than anyone in the game and also recorded the hardest shot of the night.

cards.title: Workhorse
cards.explanation: Played more minutes and skated farther than any other player in the game.

cards.title: Go-To Scorer
cards.explanation: Scored in the second period and led U.S. Collegiate Selects in shots and expected goals.

cards.title: Shot Stopper
cards.explanation: Made 26 saves, the most in the game, as Davos sent 69 shot attempts his way. 26 of the 31 shots on goal he faced stayed out.
